About

Creator Bench is a set of free, simple tools for people who make videos for YouTube, Shorts, Reels and TikTok. Each tool does one job well and runs entirely in your browser.

We don't ask for an account, and your scripts, images and videos are never uploaded. The site is supported by ads.

Creator Bench is independent and is not affiliated with YouTube, Google, Instagram, Meta or TikTok. Their names are trademarks of their owners.
